material_finding: The central FREE-provider admission boundary test supplied synthetic admission policy at root/admission.json while production load_provider_admission() resolves its default policy from root/research_entity/claycode/autonomous/FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION.json. Patching the legacy ADMISSION_PATH global did not redirect that production default. Therefore the executable discriminator could exercise a missing canonical policy path instead of the intended fixture. A concurrently-added 8.68 malformed-admission regression repeated the same noncanonical fixture-path defect.
hypothesis: Binding every blocked-case fixture to the same canonical repository-relative admission path used by production is required for the acceptance tests to discriminate admission semantics rather than fixture placement.
counterhypothesis: Patching admission_mod.ADMISSION_PATH is sufficient to redirect the production loader, so root/admission.json is equivalent.
counterhypothesis_adjudication: REJECTED_BY_SOURCE: current load_provider_admission() constructs its default target from the resolved repository root plus research_entity/claycode/autonomous/FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION.json; the ADMISSION_PATH global is not the default-path authority in that function.
